name: Nethanel (Jehoshaphat's prince)
title: Prince sent out to teach the law
summary: Nethanel was one of the princes King Jehoshaphat sent out to the cities of Judah to teach the people the Lord's law.

keyEvents.title: Teacher of the law
keyEvents.description: Nethanel was among the princes Jehoshaphat sent out to teach Judah the Lord's law.
